items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: where Jack Johnson appeared later on

ctx.x: But there wasn't enough work to go around?

There was enough, yes. There was enough. There were many, many theaters and even in Harlem there were three theaters operating that had vaudeville and shows. The Lafayette had tab shows, reviews, and the Lincoln Theater had vaudeville. And even up at 145th Street, the Roosevelt, they were doing -- on Lenox Avenue -- not the Roosevelt, Crescent I believe, where Jack Johnson appeared later on. They did vaudeville. There were plenty of places to work. And then you had the Savoy, you had -- in Harlem you had the…
